title: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2608.28281v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. Even with a capable coding agent, a loop may trust a stale progress note, skip needed verification, spend its budget in the wrong direction, or stop before the task is safe to submit. Yet the final outcome of one end-to-end run cannot tell whether success or failure reflects the loop's guidance or the coding agent's ability to carry out the task. We introduce LoopArena, a benchmark for evaluating how well one model can guide a separate coding agent through a long-running task. translated_title: LoopArena：将模型作为循环工程运行时控制器的基准测试
translated_abstract: 循环工程正在成为一种围绕编码代理组织开发工作的实践。从业者不再手动编写每一条提示词，而是设计循环来监控进度、分配工作、运行检查，并决定代理接下来应该做什么。即使拥有能力强大的编码代理，循环也可能信任过时的进度记录、跳过必要的验证、把预算花在错误的方向上，或者在任务尚未安全到可以提交之前就停止。然而，一次端到端运行的最终结果无法判断成功或失败反映的是循环的引导作用，还是编码代理执行任务的能力。我们提出 LoopArena，这是一个用于评估一个模型引导另一个独立编码代理完成长时间运行任务能力的基准。被评估的模型充当控制器：在每一轮编码结束后，它会收到本次运行的结构化摘要，并指示一个独立的、固定的编码代理（即工作者）接下来该做什么、该验证什么，或者决定……
tldr: LoopArena 提出了一个新基准，通过让被评估模型充当控制器、在每轮编码后基于结构化运行摘要指挥一个固定的编码代理（工作者），将循环的引导能力与代理的执行能力解耦，从而专门评估模型作为循环工程运行时控制器的水平。
en_tdlr: LoopArena introduces a benchmark that decouples loop guidance from agent execution by evaluating a model as a runtime Controller that, after each coding round, directs a fixed coding Worker based on structured run summaries.
